udt_struct_v0.doc:
Fund report structure matching the fields we consume from Chainlink Data Streams V12.

This remains the canonical decoded representation used by the fund contract and
local tests, even though the live Soroban verifier speaks a bytes-based ABI.
udt_struct_v0.name: FundReport

fields.doc: Unix timestamp when this report expires (0 = no expiration)
fields.name: expires_at

fields.doc: Feed ID identifying this data stream
fields.name: feed_id

fields.doc: Fee payable in the native token
fields.name: native_fee

fields.doc: Date of the NAV calculation (Unix timestamp in milliseconds)
fields.name: nav_date

fields.doc: Current NAV per share (18 decimal precision)
fields.name: nav_per_share

fields.doc: Next/expected NAV per share (18 decimal precision)
fields.name: next_nav_per_share

fields.doc: Timestamp when the observations were made (Unix timestamp in seconds)
fields.name: observations_timestamp

fields.doc: Timestamp from which this data is valid (Unix timestamp in seconds)
fields.name: valid_from_timestamp
